description: Play as Zero, kill the robots and save the day

v0.1.0.description:
Initial playable alpha. Very bare bones but should be fully playable.
## General Information
- As of right now, the only thing randomized are the secret disks that are found in levels. Each one is a location check and an AP item.

- To beat the game, players must defeat the final boss while collecting a configurable number of secret disks (default: 80). You can set this number using the required_secret_disks option in your YAML file.

- There is another option to always give the player an S ranking. Remember that this will also give each boss a new attack, making the game harder.

- You *should* be able to use savestates throughout the game without anything breaking.

## Options

- `goal`:  
  - `default` – Beat the final boss*with enough Secret Disks (default).
  - `vanilla` – Beat the final boss regardless of disks.

- `required_secret_disks`:  
  Set the number of disks needed for completion. Default is 80, max is 160.

- `easy_ex_skill`:  
  Gives you S-Rank at the end of every stage, guaranteeing EX Skill rewards. Will make some bosses harder.

## Known Bugs
- Opening a disk then loading a level will cause the disk to be unloaded the next time the hub is revisited. This one is pretty egregious and will be fixed asap.

- There are only 160 Secret Disks, the 20 disks that appear in the hub areas are currently not implemented in AP due to how I have the memory reading set up. They are still collectable in game, but they are just not going to be items or location checks.

- Save states have the possibility to screw things up, but I am not sure where.

- Theres probably some more bugs especially with world generation; I haven't really tested this too much. Seriously please help out.



## Planned Features
- The primary planned feature is more routing changes. 
  - Like how Mega Man 2 limits the available robot masters you could fight until you have the proper AP item, this world should likely do the same. 
  - Limiting Zero's default abilities (wall climb, dash, charge attack, sword combo) like how Mario World does it can also work. Although it would require editing the first level, as it cannot be completed without wall climbing.
- Fix hub area items to be collectable. 
- Deathlink support.
- Filler items (Energy Crystals, Health, Extra Lives). These are in the item pool but are currently unimplemented.
- EX Skills as optional location checks.
- Other collectables as location checks. Like static health pickups, extra lives, etc.
- Have skippable cutscenes unlocked by default. Right now having a completed save game on your file allows you to skip most cutscenes, but this should likely be a Rom edit or something similar.
- Let the player leave every level at will. By default you can only escape levels that you have beaten previously. This will be much more important later once the routing changes are implemented.

---
If you have any questions, feel free to contact me on Discord: Stingrays110, though I'd prefer if you kept it to the Zero channel on the Archipelago Discord

v0.1.3.description:
Fixed several bugs and rewritten some back end code. Be sure to check out the readme for more information before downloading.
## Changes
- Getting a game over no longer sends unintentional items. Previously it would take all archipelago items sent to you, and send them all back as location checks.
- Items collected during the games demo playback are no longer counted as location checks.
- Potentially fixed an elusive bug where it would send every single location check all at once when you finish a level. This might not be fully fixed though.
v0.1.3.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.1.3

v0.1.4.description:
Update to the item and location names for each item. Each location check has a description of where to find it, and each item has a location of what the secret disk contains.

Thank you to facetraccoon on the Archipelago discord for charting out all of the items!

Next update will likely add elemental chips and suit upgrades to the item pool, so stay tuned!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4

v0.1.5.description:
Hopefully the first ROM edit of many. This is a simple change at first, as I was getting used to the work flow of romhacking. This change will be more important as I begin to implement more routing changes. By then, entering and exiting levels will be more important.
## Changes
- Modified vanilla escape system via rom edits. You can now leave levels that you have not beaten before, except for the tutorial mission and missile factory, as those can cause issues.
v0.1.5.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.1.5

v0.1.6.description:
Added e-Reader changes as items! 68 of the secret disks in game are purely lore related and don't do anything meaningful for the player when given. Coincidentally, there are 68 total graphical changes that can be applied from the Japanese exclusive e-Reader. So, when receiving these lore secret disks, you will also automatically have a graphical change applied.

Right now it is on by default with no way to disable. In a future update I will make this a toggle-able option, along with some other customization options.

## Changes
- e-Reader graphical changes are added as a result of receiving certain secret disks from 111 to 180.
- Re-added ability to escape level from the hub area. It wasn't really causing any issues, and its useful for teleporting back to the command room.
v0.1.6.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.1.6

v0.1.7.description:
Cutscenes are now skippable by default. Note that not every cutscene is skippable, but most story sequences, mission intros, and boss intros should be fully skippable on a fresh save file.

If you are a new player, I highly recommend checking out the [readme](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago) before playing. It contains information on the world, as well as known bugs and planned features.

# Changes
- Any cutscene that is skippable on repeat playthroughs can now be skipped immediately.
- Rewrote logic for preventing player from opening disks on the results screen. Changed from a sketchy RAM insertion to ROM logic edit.
v0.1.7.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.1.7

v0.2.0.description:
[Utilizing the amazing in progress decompilation by akatsuki105](https://github.com/mmzret/rmz3), I was able to completely rewrite the back-end for this project, which should ease any issues regarding desyncs or locations unlocking when they shouldn't.

# Changes
- Back-end has been rewritten. Should be more stable and less prone to desyncs, especially when using save states.
- All 180 disks are now supported, previously only disks found in levels themselves were counted as AP items and locations.
- NPC dialogue disks are no longer missable. Talking to an NPC any time after their dialogue changes should give all previous disks that you missed out on.
- You will now be alerted in game when an Archipelago item is collected. It will display as a message box at the bottom of the screen. This feature is optional, as of right now it is very slow and distracting. I will be improving this later, but the choice is there now if you want it. (or just have text client open).

# Known Bugs
- Certain rewards given by NPCs require you to make the correct dialogue choices. Right now these are broken, and you will always receive the disk regardless of what you say. This will be fixed later.
- There's a chance that I may have missed out on a few dialogue related rewards. If there are any issues please ping me in the discord!
v0.2.0.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.2.0

v0.2.1.description:
EX Skills and Suit Chips have been implemented! 

# Changes

- Body and Leg chips have been implemented. 
- EX Skills have been implemented. 
  - These are awarded based on your score on the level you just completed, rather than on your average score going into that level (Yes that's how they worked in the vanilla game). 
  - Cyber Elves that boost your ranking for one level will also work in awarding the EX Skill location checks. Just use them before killing the boss.
- The option that forces your rank to be "S" has been replaced with an option that will always reward you with an EX Skill regardless of your rank. This option is recommended, as currently, EX Skills are missable. In a later update you will be able to revisit levels and re-attempt an A rank.

# Known Bugs
- EX Skills are currently missable. If you do not receive an A or higher on a level with an EX Skill check, there is no way to revisit it without loading an earlier save or savestate. This will be fixed in a later update. Consider using the "Always reward EX-Skill" option.
v0.2.1.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.2.1

v0.2.2.description:
Sub Tanks have been implemented!

# Changes
- Sub Tanks have been implemented as location checks and randomized items.
- This update should have performance increases. It turns out you can read multiple slots of memory in one Bizhawk read/write statement. Very cool.
- Fixed a bug where having multiple clients running on the same computer could cause the two games to incorrectly share inventory.
v0.2.2.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.2.2

v0.2.3.description:

- No longer checks any state when in Title Screen.
- Various backend improvements.
- Fixed a missing secret disk location.
- Fixed NG+ bug in Sunken Library.

v0.2.5.description:
Weapons have been added to the item pool! This is currently slightly buggy so it is optional for now. 

# Changes
- Added Zero's four weapons as optional obtainable items.
- Added EX Skill location checks for the three levels that didn't have them.

v0.2.6.description:
Just some bug fixes for this update.

# Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue regarding lost body and foot chips.
- Fixed issue where subtanks wouldn't be given properly if randomized weapons was not enabled.
- Added generation logic for location checks requiring the flame body chip and recoil rod.
v0.2.6.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.2.6

v0.2.7.description:
Some bug fixes, Energy Crystal item implementation, and Death Link support.

# New Features:
- Energy Crystals are now an item. Crystal bundles can show up in the item pool, get sent by other players, or be placed in your starting inventory. Note that you wont see these in solo sessions, as the item to location ratio is 1-1.
- Death Link support.

# Bug Fixes
- Armor chips no longer vanish. Body and foot chips were sometimes getting temporarily wiped when moving between rooms or reloading saves. Hopefully this is the last fix I have to make regarding this bug :( .
- Starting inventory actually works now for things that aren't just disks. Items you set to start with are properly given when you load in.
- Implementation regarding the loss of weapons should be fixed. I personally couldn't recreate any bugs regarding lost weapons myself, but the logic has been cleaned up. 
- Fixed the Vanilla goal. It had been quietly broken for a very long time. I guess nobody ever used it.
- Corrected a logic requirement. Oceanic Highway Ruins (1) 005: 1st Pit Breakable now correctly requires the Recoil Rod.
v0.2.7.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.2.7

v0.3.0.description:
A full rewrite! The world is now [built from a decompilation of the game](https://github.com/mmzret/rmz3) instead of patched into the ROM by hand. 

Since this update is almost a total rewrite, so there could likely be a lot of undocumented bugs, so be sure to let me know in the Discord if anything seems off!

# New Features:
- Item popups. You now get a little graphic on screen when another player sends you an item.
  - This is still a work in progress, as the icons currently don't actually represent what you've received.
- There is now a disk counter on the pause menu, so you can see how many you're holding out of how many you need for your goal to complete.
- The hub room lets you replay a stage you've already cleared, either as a free run or as the mission again. This lets you reattempt missions for another chance at an A+ rank clear, meaning that no checks in this world are missable.
- The vanilla goal option has been removed. There used to be a "vanilla" option, where you just had to beat the final boss. It has been removed, and now the only goal is to beat the boss with the set number of secret disks given. If you want the old way back, you can just set required disks to 0. I didn't feel like maintaining both options, and I don't think many people used it anyway.
# Bug Fixes
- E-Crystals filler items should no longer be lost if you load earlier saves after being sent them.
- Subtanks no longer delete their location check. Receiving a subtank from someone else used to despawn its pickup in the world, which made that location impossible to get.
- Armor chips, subtanks, and crystals no longer get temporarily deleted by a game over, and now show up immediately when you load a save.
- Fixed one of Sunken Library's disks not being reset when you load the level and have already been given the disk through an Archipelago item.
- Removed the warning telling you not to save after the credits. New Game Plus works entirely now, and saving whenever should be fine too, but you should probably keep a save game on the last level just so you can revisit all levels in the game.
v0.3.0.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.3.0

v0.3.1.description:
New feature, level access items! This changes is very  a lot of how the game plays, so I would check out the [full README](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago/) so you know what to expect. Please report any bugs as usual!

# New Features

- Every stage is now locked behind its own access item. You start in the Resistance Base with no stages accessible. The first access item is guaranteed to be early local, so check around the base and talk to NPCs.

- There's a modified mission select screen, which is visually very WIP. It works, and everything it tells you is correct, but it does not look finished yet.
  - Boss portraits are in groups of four like before, but now you can tab between the pages with left and right on the d-pad (the shoulder buttons work too). 
  - Hovering a level tells you its name, how many of its disks you have found, whether it's LOCKED / OPEN / CLEARED, and your best rank in it.
  - Picking a level you have already beaten asks you how you want to run it. EXPLORE is the vanilla revisit for picking up disks you missed. RETRY MISSION plays the level as a real mission again, so the boss is back and you get another shot at the A+ rank check.
- There are now Story Progress items in the pool. Collecting one makes the game believe you completed the first intermission (Missile Factory), collecting the second makes the game believe you completed the second intermission (Copy X). This is kind of a bandaid fix, since all it really does is advance NPC dialogue so you can get the checks from them. It will be removed later.

# Known bugs

- The level select screen is visually early access. It works, and everything it tells you is correct, but it does not look finished yet. Specifically:

  - The page with Area X-2 on it draws three portraits instead of four. The fourth one is there and selectable, and the name and info at the bottom are right, but the portrait doesn't render correctly.

  - The last page is invisible. The following four levels (Derelict Spacecraft, Missile Factory, Sub Arcadia and Weil's Lab) have no boss portrait art yet. But the text at the bottom of the screen is correct and the levels are selectable as normal.

  - Talking to the operator in the command room takes you straight to the stage select. Looks sort of strange and will be fixed later.
v0.3.1.title: Mega Man Zero 3 APWorld v0.3.1
